prompt: Create a character design comparison board for Evolution Wars, FIVE distinct original male commentator proposals numbered 1 through 5. This is a redesign of Gerard toward warmth, nerdiness, eccentricity and lived experience. All are around 45–50 years old, expressive geeks, enthusiastic talkers, thoughtful and slightly socially awkward in an endearing way, approachable and welcoming. NO celebrity likeness. NO villain, menacing gaze, cynical leering smirk, sinister squint, grizzled gangster, slick seductive look, crooked teeth, big toothy sneer, tobacco or alcohol props. They have honest expression lines, crow's feet and slightly tired eyes but a kind open expression, natural compact straight teeth only where a mouth is open. White/off-white eye sclera, warm neutral brown/gray facial hair without blue tint. Make five meaningfully different facial designs, not the same face with five expressions. Keep consistent profession and wardrobe across the proposals: blue broadcast headphones with microphone, colorful open sky-blue Hawaiian shirt with yellow lemon motifs and a few red flowers, dark charcoal T-shirt. Angular adult hands and subtle hair on forearms/fingers where visible. High-quality coherent medium-resolution pixel art, readable grouped pixels, not realistic painting and not coarse 16-bit caricature. Thin restrained dark outlines, warm skin tones, no beauty-filter smooth face. EACH portrait waist/chest-up at same scale, both hands or one conversational hand visible, friendly energetic body language. Five numbered design panels arranged THREE on the top row and TWO centered on the bottom row on a plain dark navy background, with generous separation and NO frames cutting off heads. Only text: large clear small labels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 below corresponding portraits. No titles or descriptions. Proposal 1: lean curious software-engineer type, soft oval face, high forehead with messy brown fringe, lightly graying temples, very light stubble, attentive gentle eyes, modest closed-mouth amused smile, one open conversational hand. Proposal 2: fuller friendly face, curly dark hair, rounded rectangular glasses, short neatly kept warm-gray beard, laugh lines, spontaneous good-natured open smile with small even teeth, broad relaxed shoulders; generous approachable energy. Proposal 3: longish intelligent face, wavy swept medium-brown hair slightly unruly, clean shaven, small round glasses, pronounced smile creases, thoughtful crooked EYEBROW but straight relaxed lips, pleased shy smile and a slightly hesitant open hand; peculiar lovable professor, not elderly. Proposal 4: animated slightly angular face, thick dark brows but relaxed not angry, floppy messy salt-and-pepper hair, short stubble, bright warm laugh with small straight teeth, talking with both open hands, youthful enthusiasm inside a weathered 48-year-old face. Proposal 5: broad calm kind face, receding short dark hair with gray sides, a close neat beard, no glasses, mild bags under eyes, fine wrinkles, a gentle closed-mouth half-smile with eyes crinkling warmly, slightly tilted head listening sincerely. Across all five: make kindness readable before eccentricity; friendly geek enthusiasm rather than forced clowning. Avoid copying any real person. These are alternate character concepts, not animation frames.
